title: Biotechnology & Cell Science Laboratory Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Biotechnology and Cell Science Laboratory Technician, Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: students will demonstrate knowledge of the broad scope of the biotechnology industry as well as the structure of a company and the importance of project management, workflow, and ethical practices.
Students will also be able to describe and perform foundational molecular biology techniques that introduce quantifying, manipulating, and purifying biological molecules.
Students will be able to demonstrate and articulate the importance of aseptic techniques.

Through these cumulative laboratory experiences, students will be able to apply the scientific method to design controlled experiments and perform data analysis and graphing skills to generate quality figures.

Students will also demonstrate their technical knowledge of the different types of documents and records used in a regulatory environment and communicate novel scientific findings through written and oral communication.
Finally, students will become more aware of equipment and laboratory space modifications that will promote inclusivity and accommodations for scientists living with disabilities.
